description: What to read after one particular book: the next books in its series, more by the same author, and books that read like it, the same set its siftivo.com page shows. Suits "what should I read after X", "is there a sequel to X" and "more like X". For a reader who has linked their Siftivo account, each list leaves out books already in their library and books they hid, avoided or recently passed on, and a book that fits their taste says why. Takes a workId from search_books.
